tools.name: gateway__list_servers
tools.title: List connected servers
tools.description: [Gateway] List the MCP servers (and stores) available to you, with a one-line summary and how many tools each has. Use it to decide where to search.

tools.name: acme__create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Create a simple product that is immediately visible on the storefront (status "publish" by default). If a SKU is given and already exists, the existing product is returned instead of creating a duplicate.

regular_price.description: Price in the store currency, e.g. "12.50"

tools.name: acme__get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Full details of one order: line items, totals, shipping, payment method. Contact details are masked.

tools.name: acme__get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Full details of one product by id.

tools.name: acme__get_store_info
tools.title: Store info
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Store name, URL, timezone, currency and the current local date/time. Call this first if you need to know what 'today' means for the store.

tools.name: acme__list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] List orders, newest first. For questions like "orders today" use period="today" — the date range is resolved in the store's timezone. Alternatively pass after/before as ISO dates (store-local). Customer emails are masked.

period.description: Convenience date range in store-local time

tools.name: acme__list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Search and list products in the store catalog. Returns id, name, SKU, price, stock and storefront link.

search.description: Text to match in product name/description

tools.name: acme__sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Sales totals for a period (store-local time): order count, revenue and average order value, broken down by status. Useful for comparing stores.

tools.name: acme__update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: [Acme Coffee] Change the status of an order (e.g. processing -> completed). Optionally adds a private order note.

note.description: Private note added to the order

tools.name: chaos__echo
tools.description: [Chaos test server] Echo the given text back unchanged.

tools.name: chaos__fail
tools.description: [Chaos test server] Always fails with a tool error (isError). Use it to demonstrate error handling.

tools.name: chaos__flaky
tools.description: [Chaos test server] Fails at random with the given probability (0..1).

tools.name: chaos__sleep
tools.description: [Chaos test server] Wait for the given number of milliseconds, then answer. Use it to demonstrate timeouts.

tools.name: erp__list_orders
tools.description: [Legacy ERP] List purchase orders in the legacy ERP.

tools.name: erp__list_products
tools.description: [Legacy ERP] List products in the legacy ERP catalog (not the web store).

tools.name: initech__create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Create a simple product that is immediately visible on the storefront (status "publish" by default). If a SKU is given and already exists, the existing product is returned instead of creating a duplicate.

regular_price.description: Price in the store currency, e.g. "12.50"

tools.name: initech__get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Full details of one order: line items, totals, shipping, payment method. Contact details are masked.

tools.name: initech__get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Full details of one product by id.

tools.name: initech__get_store_info
tools.title: Store info
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Store name, URL, timezone, currency and the current local date/time. Call this first if you need to know what 'today' means for the store.

tools.name: initech__list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] List orders, newest first. For questions like "orders today" use period="today" — the date range is resolved in the store's timezone. Alternatively pass after/before as ISO dates (store-local). Customer emails are masked.

period.description: Convenience date range in store-local time

tools.name: initech__list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Search and list products in the store catalog. Returns id, name, SKU, price, stock and storefront link.

search.description: Text to match in product name/description

tools.name: initech__sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Sales totals for a period (store-local time): order count, revenue and average order value, broken down by status. Useful for comparing stores.

tools.name: initech__update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: [Initech Supplies] Change the status of an order (e.g. processing -> completed). Optionally adds a private order note.

note.description: Private note added to the order
